name: ClipRoost
author: baxtiarhama

sections.description:
ClipRoost turns your WordPress posts into short vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

How it works

  1. Install the plugin and click Connect to ClipRoost in wp-admin.
  2. Sign in with Google on cliproost.com (no Application Password required).
  3. Select posts in WordPress and click Create video with ClipRoost.
  4. Style your video in the ClipRoost editor and download your MP4.

Video rendering, the editor, and billing are hosted on cliproost.com. This plugin is a bridge between your site and ClipRoost — it does not run FFmpeg or heavy processing on your server.

Privacy

This plugin sends site URL, selected post/product metadata, and connection tokens to ClipRoost servers. See privacy-policy.txt in the plugin package.

External services

This plugin connects to the ClipRoost hosted service to pair your WordPress site, import selected posts or products into the video editor, and render MP4 videos. Video editing, rendering, and account billing run on ClipRoost infrastructure — not on your WordPress server.

When data is sent

  • During site pairing: your site URL, a pairing nonce, and your Google account email (or email for magic-link sign-in).
  • When you import content: metadata for the posts or products you select (title, excerpt, permalink, featured image URL, category, price).
  • When you enable send-to-media-library: the rendered MP4 file.

Services used

  • ClipRoost API (api.cliproost.com) — site pairing, imports, usage, and media delivery.
  • ClipRoost app (app.cliproost.com) — video editor and account dashboard (opened in the browser after import).

This service is provided by ClipRoost: terms of service, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/cliproost, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to ClipRoost in the admin menu and click Connect to ClipRoost.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ClipRoost account password?

No. Connection uses Google sign-in (or magic link on cliproost.com). You never paste Application Passwords into ClipRoost.

What data is sent to ClipRoost?

Your site URL, post metadata you select for import (title, excerpt, featured image URL, permalink), and your Google account email during pairing.

Can I use WooCommerce products?

Yes. Select products under Products → All Products and use the bulk action “Create video with ClipRoost”.

Are videos added to my Media Library?

Completed renders from plugin imports can be pushed to your Media Library automatically.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. Free plan limits apply on cliproost.com. Upgrade from the plugin dashboard link.
